title: Irregular Hodge Bundles for Deligne--Mumford Landau--Ginzburg Families with Fixed Pole Orders
summary: We prove that the canonical irregular Hodge filtrations in smooth families of Deligne--Mumford Landau--Ginzburg models with fixed pole orders assemble into filtered algebraic vector bundles. More precisely, twisted de Rham cohomology forms a vector bundle carrying a canonical algebraic integrable connection, every rational irregular Hodge level is a subbundle with locally free quotient, and every rational graded piece is a vector bundle.
